messages:
Maya: opened PR to refresh the Quickstart hello-world and add a tiny migration note for SDK changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2620. Can @Ibrahim or @Sofia quick-review?
Ibrahim: quick skim 1: swap JS example to use the new SDK init and prefer `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Keep a one-line curl as a smoke check only. Also the current python snippet still uses old import names.
Sofia: I'll patch py to `from redwood import RedwoodClient` and show a safe accessor for responses. Also suggest adding a short table mapping `REDWOOD_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY` for older users.
lint-bot: /docs/lint 1 error: missing code fence language tag in the README snippet.
Maya: fixing fence tags and trimming the Dockerfile to a minimal example (no --platform flag). Adding `npm run smoke` suggestion for CI smoke checks. Pushed commit c4d8e.
Ibrahim: LGTM, one tiny wording nit: change "legacy users" to "older SDKs" in the migration table.
Sofia: added link to /guides/auth and a troubleshooting callout: "401? confirm REDWOOD_API_KEY is set and not expired."
lint-bot: re-run 1/21 checks passed.
Maya: thanks all 1 merging after final CI job. Will cherry-pick migration blurb into the migration guide post-merge. :shipit:
